parsed.note_claim: The Apollo spacecraft used onboard guidance computers (no GPS needed).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Apollo Guidance Computer (AGC) is a digital computer produced for the Apollo program that was installed on board each Apollo command module (CM) and Apollo Lunar Module (LM). The AGC provided computation and electronic interfaces for guidance, navigation, and control of the spacecraft.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that Apollo spacecraft carried onboard guidance computers for navigation and control.
